channels.evidence: Device IR provides source bytes (local_temp_high, local_temp_low), raw encoding (big-endian, 12-bit signed, right-shift 4, sign-extend from bit 11), and executable integer_approximation_expression for temp_standard formula. Channel canonicalization maps to temp_local with unit milli_degC.
Device IR provides source bytes (remote1_temp_high, remote1_temp_low), same encoding and formula as local channel. Channel canonicalization maps to temp_remote with unit milli_degC.
